Create video games."
Commercial use: Yes - royalty free for personal, commercial, and non-profit projects incl. video games (official Adobe Mixamo FAQ, helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html, last updated 2021-09-14)
Modification: Yes - auto-rig/retarget is a core Mixamo feature; FBX animation files may be modified and incorporated into projects
Attribution required: No - "Do I have to give Adobe, Mixamo, or Fuse credit in my project? No. That is up to you..." (official Adobe Mixamo FAQ / community)
Redistribution of raw asset: No standalone raw redistribution - raw character/animation files may not be redistributed as the product itself (e.g., republished as asset store packages); must be incorporated into a larger project; team-internal sharing allowed (official Adobe Mixamo FAQ, 2022). Do not push raw FBX to public repos before the post-WP166 license audit.
AI/ML: content may not be used to directly/indirectly train machine learning / AI systems (Mixamo Additional Terms section 1, 2021-06-23)
License source URL: https://www.mixamo.com/ ; https://helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html ; https://wwwimages2.adobe.com/content/dam/cc/en/legal/servicetou/Mixamo-Addl-Terms-en_US-20210623.pdf
